title.narrative: Economic and social empowerment of young women and men in western and north-western regions of Zambia

description.narrative: The joint initiative by UNFPA and UNIDO, in partnership with the Government of Zambia leverages on proven positive correlations between health, education, productivity and economic empowerment of youth in a given context. Evidence generated in Zambia underscores the fact that economic and social development cannot be addressed in silos if Zambia is to achieve its Vision of becoming a prosperous middle income country by 2030. The adoption of an integrated and multi-sectoral development approach by the Government resonates with global consensus on the interconnectedness of health, including Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH), education, and economic empowerment. Guided by the country context and status of youth in Zambia, the joint initiative in targeted sites, will aim at improving the resilience of youth to health risks and insecurities through integrated health programmes, including SRH, with necessary linkages to education and skills acquisition that will build the social capital and improve productivity of Zambia#s working age population. The joint initiative aims to improve development outcomes of young women and men, by improving opportunities for productive work for young women and men, while also improving their resilience to health risks and vulnerabilities.
